title: parse_amount crashes on amounts with a thousands separator
body: Importing a CSV export fails. parse_amount("$1,234.50") raises decimal.InvalidOperation instead of returning Decimal("1234.50"). Expected: commas used as thousands separators are accepted.

title: Monthly report crashes for a month with no invoices
body: average_invoice([]) raises ZeroDivisionError. The docstring says an empty period averages to Decimal("0.00"). Expected: return Decimal("0.00").

title: Negative quantities are accepted on invoice lines
body: line_total(Line("A", Decimal("5.00"), -2)) returns -10.00. A negative quantity is a data-entry error. Expected: raise ValueError.

title: Splitting a bill loses a cent
body: split_evenly(Decimal("100.00"), 3) returns three shares of 33.33, which add up to 99.99. The docstring promises the shares add up to exactly the total, differ by at most one cent, and earlier shares take the extra cents. Expected: [33.34, 33.33, 33.33].

title: Due date crashes for invoices dated on the 31st
body: due_date(date(2024, 1, 31), 1) raises ValueError: day is out of range for month. Also add_months(date(2024, 12, 15), 1) crashes. Expected: clamp to the last day of a shorter month (2024-02-29) and roll the year over (2025-01-15).

title: business_days_between counts the wrong days
body: business_days_between(Friday 2024-03-01, Saturday 2024-03-02) returns 1, but the docstring says Friday to Saturday is 0 and Friday to Monday is 1. It should count days after the start up to and including the end.

title: Tax is off by a cent on some invoices
body: tax_for(Decimal("2.00"), Decimal("0.0825")) returns 0.17. The exact tax is 0.165, which under our banker's rounding policy (round_cents, policy ACC-12) is 0.16. Expected: tax uses exact Decimal maths and round_cents.

title: Quote total differs from the invoice the customer is billed
body: For one line of 100.00 with a 10% discount and 10% tax, quote_total returns 100.00 but invoice_total returns 99.00. Policy is discounts before tax, and the quote must always equal the invoice. Expected: quote_total equals invoice_total.
